text: しあわせそうに　みえるわ　グリーンにも　みならって　ほしい　くらいね

structure.jp: みならって　ほしい　くらいね
structure.en: I almost want him to follow the example

patterns.name: 〜そう
patterns.explanation: そう says something looks that way. しあわせそうに　みえる = 'looks happy'.

patterns.name: 〜てほしい
patterns.span: みならって　ほしい
patterns.explanation: てほしい says you want someone to do something. みならって　ほしい = 'I want (him) to follow the example'.

patterns.name: 〜くらい
patterns.explanation: くらい says the feeling is about to that degree. ほしい　くらい = 'almost wish'.
